summary: NFT Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of CFO Jianguang Qian effective May 7, 2026. The departure is stated as not due to any disagreement with the company on accounting, operations, policies, or practices. The board is searching for a qualified replacement and expects to appoint one in due course. This is a sudden CFO resignation disclosed in a foreign private issuer report. What to watch: speed of appointment and any subsequent governance or financial reporting changes.
